annotations.title: Get a download URL for one artifact

description: Mints a short-lived signed URL for one sealed artifact. Fetch it yourself with a plain GET and no headers; it expires. Example: {"run_id": "…", "artifact_id": "…"}. Returns {url, expires_at, media_type, digest, size_bytes, kind}. Cite the digest. Artifact ids come from run_artifacts. Do not use this to read a few rows — query_run is the cheaper answer. Reads past the free sample (the first 500 rows of a table in stored order) count against the workspace's shared free monthly allowance of 100,000 rows and 1,000 queries (the workspace of the key or grant in use) unless it is subscribed. A download counts the rows it contains, plus one query per table. At the limit the tool answers usage_limit_exceeded with the reset time and an upgrade URL.
name: get_artifact_download
title: Get a download URL for one artifact
